Differences from your request, so you can adapt now:
  > - **Per-draw rows are not delivered** (~10^7 rows). `target_level_n100.csv.gz` has one row per (bench, split, n=100, method, target) with `true_score`, `est_mean` (mean over subset draws), `bias`, `draw_var`, `sq_err`, `family`, `n_over_N`, `qualifies_extrap`; the all-n file is a release asset.
  > - Method name = `<design>|<estimator group>` (dictionary in the schema file). Primary n = 100; splits: interp (random 5-fold over models), lineage (5-fold over families; not legalbench), extrap (targets = top 25 % of models, all above every source), definitions in `PROTOCOL.md`.
  > - CIs: `primary.csv`/`ratio_by_n.csv` carry the geometric-mean RMSE ratio to `uniform|mean` over benchmarks with the 95 % family-bootstrap interval, flag `non_thin`/`all`; `targets.csv` has k targets, #families, `thin` per (bench, split); `per_bench.csv` has the per-benchmark ratios (no CI per benchmark yet; ask if you need one).
  > - C4 uses Brier-based `q_*` (fraction of Bernoulli variance explained on unsampled items) in `ceiling.csv`, not item-level AUC.
  > - C5: `pairwise.csv` has accuracy by |gap| bin and the analytic sample-only reference `ref_acc` (SRS, from each pair's own disagreement); `ordering.csv` has Spearman/Kendall/top-decile.
